name: Prepify
summary: Prepify is an AI-powered SaaS platform that allows job seekers to conduct real-time voice mock interviews with AI evaluators powered by Vapi SDK, Gemini, and ChatGPT.
recruiterExplanation: Prepify demonstrates Cimil's capability to deliver modern, voice-first AI web products using contemporary frontend stacks. By integrating low-latency conversational voice streams via Vapi SDK with multimodal LLMs (Gemini and ChatGPT), Cimil created an intuitive user experience for candidate preparation complete with dynamic performance tracking and instant feedback reports.
technicalExplanation: The frontend is built with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui with Tailwind CSS. Conversational audio streaming is handled through the Vapi Web SDK, connecting candidates to low-latency voice AI agents. Backend logic integrates Google's Gemini API and OpenAI ChatGPT API to dynamically formulate domain-specific interview questions, transcribe user responses, evaluate behavioral and technical depth, and output structured rubric scores. Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore store candidate interview history, evaluation transcripts, and analytics.
architectureExplanation: Client-centric modern SaaS architecture. Audio streaming connects via WebRTC/WebSockets to Vapi voice infrastructure, while serverless Next.js API routes coordinate LLM evaluations and update Firestore documents in real time.
features: Conversational Real-Time AI Voice Mock Interviews via Vapi SDK
Dual AI Scoring & Feedback using Gemini & ChatGPT APIs
Secure Firebase Authentication & Firestore Data Sync
Clean, Accessible UI built with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS

faqs.q: How does Prepify handle real-time voice without high latency?
faqs.a: Prepify leverages Vapi's Web SDK, which provides low-latency voice streaming over WebSockets and WebRTC, managing speech-to-text, LLM generation, and text-to-speech with natural conversational pacing.

faqs.q: What kind of feedback does candidate receive?
faqs.a: Candidates receive rubric-based scoring on technical correctness, clarity, confidence, and structure, accompanied by specific actionable tips generated by Gemini and ChatGPT.
